name: First Survey
description: Collect and analyse your first samples for OERA.

objectives.description: Launch Remora from the Science Lab or the Launch Bay
Take a water sample at Mystic Reef with Remora's spectrometer
Drill a rock core at Vineyard Ledge, about 16 nm south of Woods Hole
Analyse both samples in the Science Lab
Send your findings to OERA from the Comms station

message.subject: Survey results: well done
message.text:
Captain,

Your first survey data has reached the Directorate. The reef water readings and the ledge core are both useful, and Dr. Patel's analysis was thorough.

We have released a small research budget to the Aqua Nova science department. Dr. Patel will know how to spend it. Further survey requests for the shelf and the canyon will follow.

O.E.R.A. Operations Directorate

onComplete.text: Captain, one more thing. The WSKRs are commissioned. They are small remote sensors that scout ahead of the ship. Deploy them from Sensors.
